newsitem.title: SPAIN: Spain's Navarra issued 5 bln pta 10-year bond.
newsitem.headline: Spain's Navarra issued 5 bln pta 10-year bond.

text.p: The Spanish regional government of Navarra said on Monday it issued five billion pesetas in 10-year bonds.
The bond, with a minimum nominal tranche of 100,000 pesetas, will pay a yearly coupon of 6.75 percent.
Pay date is June 11, with maturity on June 11, 2007.
The central government approved the Navarre issuance.
The Navarre government needs to replace 15 billion pesetas of bonds maturing this year and it said it intends to issue more bonds this autumn.
"If we issue more bonds, we'll do it with issuance of five billion pesetas each," the source said.
